purpose: Expose the canonical DS-D1 meta-type inventory and explicit implementation-conformance coverage without changing DomainSpec formation or maturity authority.

meta_types.label: Entity
meta_types.plain_language: An identity-bearing object that is tracked through a lifecycle.
meta_types.mapping_reason: No implementation-conformance source class or architecture realization type is declared yet.
meta_types.review_trigger: A selected profile defines observable identity and lifecycle realization properties.

meta_types.label: Value Object
meta_types.plain_language: An immutable value whose identity is its complete field tuple.
meta_types.mapping_reason: No implementation-conformance source class or architecture realization type is declared yet.
meta_types.review_trigger: A selected profile separates value equality evidence from object identity evidence.

meta_types.label: Enum
meta_types.plain_language: A fixed finite set of named values with no identity or lifecycle.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The ontology declares an Enum realization type reciprocally bound to current DS-D1.3.
meta_types.review_trigger: A selected profile defines native finite-value and exhaustiveness evidence.

meta_types.label: Operation
meta_types.plain_language: A business action that changes system state.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The language profile names an Operation source class and the ontology declares a matching realization type.
meta_types.review_trigger: Canonical binding fixtures and a source adapter can prove the alignment.

meta_types.label: Query
meta_types.plain_language: A read-only request that retrieves information without changing state.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The language profile names a Query source class and the ontology declares a matching realization type.
meta_types.review_trigger: Canonical binding fixtures and a source adapter can prove the alignment.

meta_types.label: Calculation
meta_types.plain_language: A deterministic pure function that returns a value.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The language profile names a Calculation source class, but the architecture ontology has no realization type for it.
meta_types.review_trigger: Add a typed realization contract with purity and dependency evidence.

meta_types.label: Rule
meta_types.plain_language: A boolean guard that blocks or allows behavior.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The language profile names a Rule source class and the ontology declares a matching realization type.
meta_types.review_trigger: Canonical binding fixtures and a source adapter can prove the alignment.

meta_types.label: Policy
meta_types.plain_language: Decision logic that selects a strategy instead of returning yes or no.
meta_types.mapping_reason: No implementation-conformance source class or architecture realization type is declared yet.
meta_types.review_trigger: A selected profile separates strategy selection from boolean Rule realization.

meta_types.label: Workflow
meta_types.plain_language: An ordered multi-step orchestration with a declared scope.
meta_types.mapping_reason: No implementation-conformance source class or architecture realization type is declared yet.
meta_types.review_trigger: A selected profile defines orchestration, step, and scope evidence.

meta_types.label: Interface
meta_types.plain_language: A typed boundary exposing operations or queries to a consumer.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The language profile names an Interface source class and the ontology declares a matching realization type.
meta_types.review_trigger: Canonical binding fixtures and a source adapter can prove the alignment.

meta_types.label: Event
meta_types.plain_language: A typed past fact describing something that already happened.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The language profile names an Event source class, but the architecture ontology has no realization type for it.
meta_types.review_trigger: Add a typed realization contract with publication and payload evidence boundaries.

meta_types.label: Mapping
meta_types.plain_language: A field-by-field translation between two data shapes.
meta_types.mapping_reason: No implementation-conformance source class or architecture realization type is declared yet.
meta_types.review_trigger: A selected profile defines source, target, direction, and transformation evidence.

meta_types.label: State Machine
meta_types.plain_language: An explicit lifecycle made of states and allowed transitions.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The language profile names a State Machine source class and the ontology declares a matching realization type.
meta_types.review_trigger: Canonical binding fixtures and a source adapter can prove the alignment.

meta_types.label: Page
meta_types.plain_language: A UI destination that owns its route and primary content.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Candidate shape evidence does not make Page active or supported by implementation conformance.
meta_types.review_trigger: DS-D1 owner promotion with independent route-framework evidence.

meta_types.label: Layout
meta_types.plain_language: A reusable UI frame that wraps destination-specific page content.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Candidate shape evidence does not make Layout active or supported by implementation conformance.
meta_types.review_trigger: DS-D1 owner promotion with independent layout evidence.

meta_types.label: Component
meta_types.plain_language: A reusable visual unit without independent route or domain authority.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Candidate shape evidence does not make Component active or supported by implementation conformance.
meta_types.review_trigger: DS-D1 owner promotion with separating UI-unit evidence.

meta_types.label: View Model
meta_types.plain_language: A display-focused data shape that does not become domain truth.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Candidate shape evidence does not make View Model active or supported by implementation conformance.
meta_types.review_trigger: DS-D1 owner promotion with independent display-shape evidence.

meta_types.label: Hook
meta_types.plain_language: A typed reactive state or effect contract, not merely a named function.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Candidate shape evidence does not make Hook active or supported by implementation conformance.
meta_types.review_trigger: DS-D1 owner promotion after the Hook and Binding boundary is resolved.

meta_types.label: Form
meta_types.plain_language: The complete input, validation, error, and submission flow.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Candidate shape evidence does not make Form active or supported by implementation conformance.
meta_types.review_trigger: DS-D1 owner promotion with independent form evidence.

meta_types.label: Action
meta_types.plain_language: A named user intent with observable success and failure outcomes.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Candidate shape evidence does not make Action active or supported by implementation conformance.
meta_types.review_trigger: DS-D1 owner promotion after Action-source relationships are resolved.

meta_types.label: Guard
meta_types.plain_language: A non-authoritative UI gate that applies an existing Rule.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Candidate shape evidence does not make Guard active or supported by implementation conformance.
meta_types.review_trigger: DS-D1 owner promotion after the protected-surface scope is resolved.

meta_types.label: Binding
meta_types.plain_language: A durable record of how a UI surface reaches and refreshes data.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Candidate shape evidence does not make Binding active or supported by implementation conformance.
meta_types.review_trigger: DS-D1 owner promotion after the Hook and relationship boundary is resolved.

meta_types.label: Adapter
meta_types.plain_language: A proposed UI boundary type that currently collapses into Mapping.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Adapter is a deferred merge candidate for DS-D1.13 Mapping and must not be equated with architecture.AdapterImplementation.
meta_types.review_trigger: New registered evidence demonstrates a separating formation contract.

meta_types.label: State Indicator
meta_types.plain_language: A proposed visual-state type whose domain and request-state meanings remain split.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The domain-state and asynchronous request-state branches remain unresolved.
meta_types.review_trigger: The DS-D1 owner resolves the split with independent evidence.

meta_types.label: Saga
meta_types.plain_language: A retired label preserved so its identifier is never silently reused.
meta_types.mapping_reason: Saga was replaced by DS-D1.9 Workflow and its stable identifier cannot be reused.
meta_types.review_trigger: Historical evidence refers to the retired identifier.
